usedFor: Zenventory holds purchase and customer orders, and Google Drive shares a file through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Order” in Zenventory, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new customer order can share a file by link, with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so use it for public files only.
